note: All regimes implemented as direct NS-3.45 simulator callbacks, not post-hoc labels

regimes.label: benign
regimes.physical_scenario: Normal UDP/CBR traffic, RandomWaypoint mobility at 1.5 m/s, TX power 20 dBm

regimes.label: congestion
regimes.ns3_implementation: Traffic rate raised to 100 pps via MlFgaSender::SetRate() callback at t=140s
regimes.physical_scenario: High traffic load causing FQ-CoDel queue overflow and queue_overflow drop events

regimes.label: mobility
regimes.ns3_implementation: Node speed raised to 12.0 m/s via RandomWaypointMobilityModel::SetAttribute() at t=260s; traffic restored to 5 pps
regimes.physical_scenario: High node mobility causing frequent link breaks and phy_drop / collision events

regimes.label: interference
regimes.ns3_implementation: TX power reduced to 4 dBm via WifiPhy::SetTxPowerStart/End() at t=380s; speed restored to 1.5 m/s
regimes.physical_scenario: Low TX power causing PHY reception failures and phy_collision drop events

regimes.label: malicious
regimes.ns3_implementation: Blackhole and selective-forward nodes activated at t=500s; TX power restored to 20 dBm
regimes.physical_scenario: ~8% of nodes drop forwarded packets; blackhole_activated and selective_activated events logged
